# hydra_oauth2_client (Resource)

OAuth 2.0 client of a self-hosted Ory Hydra (`/admin/clients`). Updates use `PUT` (full replacement). The client secret is write-only and never stored in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Public client (no secret) that exchanges CI OIDC tokens via the
# RFC 7523 jwt-bearer grant (see hydra_trusted_jwt_grant_issuer).
resource "hydra_oauth2_client" "ci" {
  client_id                  = "forgejo-ci"
  client_name                = "Forgejo Actions"
  token_endpoint_auth_method = "none"
  grant_types                = ["urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer"]
  scope                      = "apicurio:developer"

  jwt_bearer_grant_access_token_lifespan = "10m"
}

# Confidential client: the secret is write-only (never in plan/state).
# Bump client_secret_wo_version to push a rotated secret.
variable "svc_client_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "hydra_oauth2_client" "svc" {
  client_id                = "svc"
  grant_types              = ["client_credentials"]
  scope                    = "svc:read"
  client_secret_wo         = var.svc_client_secret
  client_secret_wo_version = 1

  client_credentials_grant_access_token_lifespan = "15m"
  metadata = jsonencode({
    owner = "platform"
  })
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (String) OAuth 2.0 client ID (immutable; changing it replaces the client). Import ID.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `access_token_strategy` (String) Per-client access token strategy (`opaque` or `jwt`), overrides `strategies.access_token`.
- `allowed_cors_origins` (List of String) Allowed CORS origins.
- `audience` (List of String) Allowed audiences for access tokens.
- `authorization_code_grant_access_token_lifespan` (String) Token lifespan as a Go duration (`1h`, `10m`, `720h`); `10m` and `10m0s` are equal. Unset = Hydra's global default.
- `authorization_code_grant_id_token_lifespan` (String) Token lifespan as a Go duration (`1h`, `10m`, `720h`); `10m` and `10m0s` are equal. Unset = Hydra's global default.
- `authorization_code_grant_refresh_token_lifespan` (String) Token lifespan as a Go duration (`1h`, `10m`, `720h`); `10m` and `10m0s` are equal. Unset = Hydra's global default.
- `backchannel_logout_session_required` (Boolean) Require `sid` in back-channel logout tokens. Defaults to `false` on the server.
- `backchannel_logout_uri` (String) OIDC back-channel logout URI.
- `client_credentials_grant_access_token_lifespan` (String) Token lifespan as a Go duration (`1h`, `10m`, `720h`); `10m` and `10m0s` are equal. Unset = Hydra's global default.
- `client_name` (String) Human-readable client name.
- `client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only client secret (OpenTofu >= 1.11 / Terraform >= 1.11). Sent to Hydra on create and whenever `client_secret_wo_version` changes; never stored in plan or state. Required when creating a client whose `token_endpoint_auth_method` uses the secret (`client_secret_basic` - the default -, `client_secret_post`, `client_secret_jwt`). Minimum 6 characters (Hydra).
- `client_secret_wo_version` (Number) Rotation trigger for `client_secret_wo`: change it (e.g. increment) to send the current `client_secret_wo` to Hydra. Without a change the stored secret hash is left untouched.
- `client_uri` (String) URL of the client's home page.
- `contacts` (List of String) Contact e-mail addresses.
- `device_authorization_grant_access_token_lifespan` (String) Token lifespan as a Go duration (`1h`, `10m`, `720h`); `10m` and `10m0s` are equal. Unset = Hydra's global default.
- `device_authorization_grant_id_token_lifespan` (String) Token lifespan as a Go duration (`1h`, `10m`, `720h`); `10m` and `10m0s` are equal. Unset = Hydra's global default.
- `device_authorization_grant_refresh_token_lifespan` (String) Token lifespan as a Go duration (`1h`, `10m`, `720h`); `10m` and `10m0s` are equal. Unset = Hydra's global default.
- `frontchannel_logout_session_required` (Boolean) Require `iss`/`sid` on front-channel logout. Defaults to `false` on the server.
- `frontchannel_logout_uri` (String) OIDC front-channel logout URI.
- `grant_types` (List of String) Allowed grant types, e.g. `client_credentials`, `authorization_code`, `refresh_token`, `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer`, `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code`. Unknown values only produce a warning (Hydra does not validate this list).
- `implicit_grant_access_token_lifespan` (String) Token lifespan as a Go duration (`1h`, `10m`, `720h`); `10m` and `10m0s` are equal. Unset = Hydra's global default.
- `implicit_grant_id_token_lifespan` (String) Token lifespan as a Go duration (`1h`, `10m`, `720h`); `10m` and `10m0s` are equal. Unset = Hydra's global default.
- `jwks` (String) Inline JSON Web Key Set (public keys only) as a JSON string, e.g. `jsonencode({keys = [...]})`. Every key needs `alg`, `kid`, `kty` and `use`. Prefer `jwks_uri`.
- `jwks_uri` (String) URL of the client's JSON Web Key Set.
- `jwt_bearer_grant_access_token_lifespan` (String) Token lifespan as a Go duration (`1h`, `10m`, `720h`); `10m` and `10m0s` are equal. Unset = Hydra's global default.
- `logo_uri` (String) URL of the client's logo.
- `metadata` (String) Arbitrary JSON metadata as a JSON string (compared semantically, e.g. `jsonencode({...})`).
- `owner` (String) Owner of the client.
- `policy_uri` (String) URL of the privacy policy.
- `post_logout_redirect_uris` (List of String) Allowed post-logout redirect URIs.
- `redirect_uris` (List of String) Allowed redirect URIs.
- `refresh_token_grant_access_token_lifespan` (String) Token lifespan as a Go duration (`1h`, `10m`, `720h`); `10m` and `10m0s` are equal. Unset = Hydra's global default.
- `refresh_token_grant_id_token_lifespan` (String) Token lifespan as a Go duration (`1h`, `10m`, `720h`); `10m` and `10m0s` are equal. Unset = Hydra's global default.
- `refresh_token_grant_refresh_token_lifespan` (String) Token lifespan as a Go duration (`1h`, `10m`, `720h`); `10m` and `10m0s` are equal. Unset = Hydra's global default.
- `request_object_signing_alg` (String) Request object signing algorithm.
- `request_uris` (List of String) Allowed request URIs.
- `response_types` (List of String) Allowed response types (e.g. `code`, `id_token`, `token`).
- `scope` (String) Space-separated list of scopes the client may request. Hydra fills in a default when omitted.
- `sector_identifier_uri` (String) Sector identifier URI (pairwise subjects).
- `skip_consent` (Boolean) Skip the consent screen. Defaults to `false` on the server.
- `skip_logout_consent` (Boolean) Skip the logout consent screen. Defaults to `false` on the server.
- `subject_type` (String) Subject type: `public` or `pairwise`. Hydra fills in a default when omitted.
- `token_endpoint_auth_method` (String) Token endpoint auth method: `client_secret_basic` (default), `client_secret_post`, `client_secret_jwt`, `private_key_jwt` or `none` (public client). Hydra fills in a default when omitted.
- `token_endpoint_auth_signing_alg` (String) Signing algorithm for `private_key_jwt` / `client_secret_jwt`.
- `tos_uri` (String) URL of the terms of service.
- `userinfo_signed_response_alg` (String) Userinfo signing algorithm: `none` or `RS256`. Hydra fills in a default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Same as `client_id`.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = hydra_oauth2_client.ci
  id = "forgejo-ci" # client_id
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the client_id.
tofu import hydra_oauth2_client.ci forgejo-ci
```
